body.p: Various settings related to AI actions can be configured in Options Preferences Plugins Oxygen AI Positron Actions, Agents, and Skills .

dlentry.dt: Load default actions, agents, and skills
dlentry.dd: Specifies if default provided actions, agents and skills should be loaded.

You can use this option to specify one or more local folders (one per line) where you have stored additional actions and agents, and skills. To add, edit, or remove folders, use the Add, Edit, Remove buttons below the text box.Skill folders can be packed as zip archives with the .skill file extension. The AI Positron will dynamically load the skills from the archives.

dd.p: You can specify a comma-separated list of IDs for the actions or agents that you do not want to be loaded and presented in the list of available actions or used directly or indirectly by the add-on. Use the menu to the right of the text field to choose the actions to exclude.

dlentry.dt: Embed AI Positron in Author page
dlentry.dd: Controls whether or not the AI Positron drop-down widget is displayed when documents are open in the Author visual editing mode. This drop-down list contains some of the most useful AI actions for creating and improving the structure and content of the current document.

dlentry.dt: Show actions as buttons in Chat view
dlentry.dd: If selected, the AI actions are displayed in the main chat pane in addition to the other UI locations where the actions are presented.

dlentry.dt: Add the tools contributed by plugins to all chat modes
dlentry.dd:
Enabled by default, this option makes AI tools contributed by other plugins and add-ons available in all chat modes and sub-agents, without requiring each chat mode or sub-agent to list them. The tools that contributes (such as compare_documents, find_possible_reusable_content, and validate_with_schematron), are always added the same way, whether this option is enabled or not. The following exceptions apply to both:
A sub-agent defined in a Markdown file that lists its own tools has access only to those tools.
The Ask chat mode is offered only contributed tools that declare they do not make changes.
A chat mode that runs from a transformation through the AI XPath functions has access only to the tools it lists.
A contributed tool that replaces a built-in tool is offered only in chat modes that use the built-in tool.

dlentry.dt: Ask for confirmation before running the tools contributed by plugins
dlentry.dd: Enabled by default, this option causes the chat to request your confirmation before the AI runs a tool contributed by another plugin or add-on, unless you always allow the tool (see ). When this option is cleared, tools contributed by plugins request confirmation only for calls they declare unsafe, as other tools do. In addition, the plugin: entries on the Unsafe tool auto-approval preferences page no longer apply.

dlentry.dt: Merge AI edits into the open Author document
dlentry.dd: When the target XML document is open in the Author editing mode, this option (enabled by default) controls whether AI edits are merged into the document as individual changes, taking the current Track Changes state into account, instead of overwriting the file on disk and reloading it in the editor.

p.note: Custom actions are loaded and shown first in the UI locations where the actions are presented.
